_comment: Researched 2026-11-19. Release: August 3, 2023 on PC (Larian moved it up from August 31; Larian Steam blog, June 29, 2023, reported by Shacknews and VGC); PS5 on September 6, 2023; Xbox Series X|S surprise-released December 7, 2023 (Larian press release); Mac with the PC version. Names from the story as covered by Wikipedia and the Baldur's Gate 3 wiki: the origin companions (Astarion, Shadowheart, Karlach, Lae'zel, Gale, Wyll, the Dark Urge), Halsin, Minthara, Jaheira, Minsc, the Dead Three's Chosen (Orin, Enver Gortash, Ketheric Thorm), the Emperor, the Netherbrain/Elder Brain, Orpheus, Raphael and the House of Hope, Cazador, Mizora, Withers, Moonrise Towers, Grymforge, the Shadow-Cursed Lands. Voice cast: Neil Newbon (Astarion), Jennifer English (Shadowheart), Samantha Béart (Karlach), Devora Wilde (Lae'zel), Tim Downie (Gale), Theo Solomon (Wyll), Amelia Tyler (Narrator). Weak words: Gale, Orin, Raphael, Emperor, Absolute, Withers, Bane, Nightsong, Dark Urge, Mind Flayer, Elder Brain and Moonrise Towers are first names or ordinary words. 'Baldur's Gate' alone is weak: it is also the city, the earlier games (1998, 2000) and Dungeons & Dragons books; Baldur is also a God of War character. Bhaal, Myrkul, Illithid, Mind Flayer, Jaheira, Minsc and Volo are shared with Dungeons & Dragons and the earlier Baldur's Gate games, so they are weak. Every voice actor is weak. Accounts: @baldursgate3 (the game's own account). @larianstudios is left out: Larian now posts mostly about its next game, Divinity. Handles from Larian's site and coverage; verified status not checked live. Trimmed 2026-11-19 by the main session: removed very common first names, real cities, Marvel/mythology overlaps and famous actors (Emperor, Absolute, The Absolute, Withers, Bane, Raphael, Isobel, House of Hope), and generic backup words, so ordinary posts are not covered.
name: Baldur's Gate 3
platforms: PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Mac
